variables.name: content_pool
variables.description: Posts keyed by id (Instagram shortcode). Fields: id, content, time (Unix milliseconds), url, user_id (account username), username (display name), comment_count, comments. Runtime post_id and timestamp aliases support shared events and metrics. Comments use comment_id, post_id, user_id, username, content, time/timestamp and parent_comment_id.

variables.name: current_timestamp
variables.description: Simulation clock in Unix milliseconds; advances using the configured schedule.

variables.name: timestamp_duration
variables.description: Width of the next post window in milliseconds.

variables.name: simulation_start_timestamp
variables.description: Anchor time at load; used with max_span_days to cap timeline.

variables.name: current_step
variables.description: 1-based step counter updated after each SimEnv._save_step_data.

variables.name: current_posts
variables.description: Subset of content_pool with post.time < window_end; comments truncated for prompts using the Facebook selection logic.

variables.name: mention_pool
variables.description: user_id -> comment_id -> notification containing post_id, comment_id, mentioner, mentioner_username, mention_type and timestamp.

variables.name: seed_root_post_ids
variables.description: Frozen list of initial content_pool keys at env load; used by PostDepthGate and diffusion metrics for hop depth / seed attribution.

variables.name: reference_embedding_path
variables.description: Instagram reference embeddings: datasets/ins/embeddings/bge-base-en-v1.5_embeddings.json.

variables.name: post_embeddings_path
variables.description: Alias / override for reference_embedding_path (post embedding JSON).

variables.name: recommended_post_ids
variables.description: Flat list of post IDs already recommended to this user (legacy union).

variables.name: recommended_post_ids_by_channel
variables.description: source_type (algorithm|social|search|bookmark) -> step -> [post_id].

variables.name: mentioned_post_ids_by_channel
variables.description: mention_type (at|repost|quote|reply) -> step -> [post_id].

variables.name: bookmark_post_ids
variables.description: At most one post ID to re-expose next round via BookmarkEvent.

variables.name: recommendations
variables.description: Transient recommendation payload on profile (schema compat).

variables.name: mentions
variables.description: Transient mention payload on profile (schema compat).

variables.name: last_login_timestamp
variables.description: Last social-feed scan time (seconds); social feed uses [last_login, window_end).

variables.name: historical_posts
variables.description: Historical post IDs received.

variables.name: historical_summary
variables.description: Persona summary used in LLM prompts.

variables.name: role
variables.description: recommendation | search.

variables.name: current_posts
variables.description: Mirror of env current_posts updated on StartEvent.

variables.name: recommended_post_ids_by_user
variables.description: user_id -> list of post IDs ever pushed to that user.

variables.name: coarse_interest_recommendation_content_pool
variables.description: Platform-shared coarse interest posts from recommendation.json.

variables.name: fine_interest_recommendation_content_pool
variables.description: Topic-specific fine interest posts from topics/{slug}/recommendation.json.

variables.name: interest_recommendation_content_pool
variables.description: Merged coarse+fine interest pool used by Algorithm.interest().

variables.name: candidate_post_ids_by_user
variables.description: Topic-level user_id -> candidate post IDs from topics/{slug}/recommendation.json.

variables.name: random_rec_mau
variables.description: Random recommendation platform MAU.

variables.name: random_rec_avg_posts_per_user_month
variables.description: Random recommendation avg posts per user per month.

variables.name: recommendations
variables.description: Transient recommendation output (schema compat).
